analysis.search_intent: 이 버튼이 Orbs 한 개를 실제로 없애는지 확인하려는 검색이에요.

analysis_en.detailed_summary: The “Orbs Voided” readout tracks how many have already been discarded. The action names a single Orb, and the accompanying notice says thrown Orbs are destroyed.
analysis_en.search_intent: Does the throw button remove one Orb from my balance?
analysis_en.source_context: The same window contained consent, Orb disposal, balance and badge progress copy, alongside the corresponding experiment and Orb action.
analysis_en.summary: “Throw an orb into the void” is the action for discarding one Orb.
analysis_en.what_it_means: The action names a single Orb, and the accompanying notice says thrown Orbs are destroyed.
analysis_en.when_it_appears: It belongs to the part of The Void where you can act on your Orb balance.
